feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Diesel prices soar as U.S. farmers preparing for harvest continue to feel squeezed
entry.summary: Diesel prices have spiked just in time for corn and soybean harvests. Farmers need the fuel to bring in the crops, and many were already hurting, but there are factors offsetting this latest setback.

entry.title: The first day of school: Bells, bikes, buses and big feelings
entry.summary: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

entry.title: Former crime reporter John Simpson shares why he decided to go to clown school
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with former crime reporter John Simpson about Simpson's decision to go to clown school.

entry.title: Labor unions nationwide are navigating the explosive growth of AI
entry.summary: Unions are trying to figure out where they stand on AI. While some are focused on greater protections for workers, the building trades unions are already reaping benefits from the data center boom.

entry.title: 5 dead after Amazon cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport
entry.summary: Five people were killed when a cargo plane crashed at the Miami International Airport on Sunday.

entry.title: Former inspector general on what investigators will look for in Miami plane crash
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel talks with Mary Schiavo, former inspector general for the Department of Transportation, about what authorities will look for in the Miami plane crash investigation.

entry.title: The price of diesel is showing up in the price of almost everything
entry.summary: Diesel has hit a record high. Stephan Bisaha visits an Alabama truck stop to talk with drivers and business owners about how high prices are changing what they spend and charge.

entry.title: A trucker explains what record diesel prices mean for his business
entry.summary: Monte Wiederhold runs a trucking company in northwest Ohio. He explains how problems overseas affect businesses at home.

entry.title: Investigators seek answers after Amazon cargo plane crash kills five at Miami airport
entry.summary: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

entry.title: A year after Charlie Kirk's death, TPUSA is still influencing young conservatives
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks with Ali Breland, who covers the far-right for The Atlantic, about the conservative youth organization Turning Point USA, now one year after Charlie Kirk's assassination.
